text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia on Monday celebrates Agriculture Day. President expected to deliver speech.
- L'Etoile Sportive du Sahel already winner of the Tunisian soccer championship two matches before the end of the season.
- The building of a marina south of the Hammamet resort to start soon.
- Belgium travel operators visit the Tunisian island of Djerba.
